Put Raw Responses on the Fitting Scale

Source: R/response_adjustment.R
transform_sample_response.Rd

The single transform for test samples and controls, matching what preprocess_standards() does to the standards: subtract the blank value (if any), add the offset, then log10 on the log path. Values still <= 0 after the adjustment are set to display_floor.

Usage

transform_sample_response(
  raw,
  is_log_response,
  adjustment = NULL,
  display_floor = NULL
)

Arguments

raw

Numeric. Raw responses.

is_log_response

Logical.

adjustment

List from compute_response_adjustment() (or the derived_stats of preprocess_standards()), or NULL. NULL keeps the legacy behaviour (no subtraction, no offset, floor 1e-6) for callers that have not been given an adjustment.

display_floor

Numeric or NULL. Floor for values still <= 0; defaults to adjustment$response_floor, else 1e-6.

Value

Numeric vector on the fitting scale.
